title: Bank fraud team verifying a transaction

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, this is Rohan calling from ICICI Bank card security.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We have flagged a transaction of 42,000 rupees on your credit card at an online store. Did you authorise this payment?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Okay, I am blocking the card right now for your safety. A new card will reach you in five working days.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: You will receive an SMS confirming the block. Please do not share your OTP or card details with anyone who calls you.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: You can raise a dispute in the mobile app or at your branch. Thank you.
